description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Dark with Stacking], [Awoken Dark], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dark Ability Instant Cast (15s)] and [Vanish Mode] to the user

description.name: Attach Dark with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3

description.name: Awoken Dark
description.text: Dark abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Dark abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Dark Ability Instant Cast (15s)
description.text: Instant cast speed for Dark abilities

description.name: Vanish Mode
description.text: Grants [Dark Ability +30% Boost 1] to the user after using two Dark abilities
